sources.title: Seed2.1 Officially Released: Advancing AI Productivity
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The original June 23 announcement names Pro and describes its agent, coding and multimodal improvements. It supplies no nominal total or active count and no explicit mapping to a publicly sized base; general improvement from Seed2.0 is not a shared-weight declaration.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full text of the 73-page official PDF freshly retrieved October 27 in the shared cache. Read the Pro-specific introduction and Tables 9–11; these report vision, video and language benchmark scores. Full-text count/activation/base-lineage searches found no nominal total, active count or sized-base mapping. Generic model-development iteration is not parameter lineage.

sources.title: Volcano Ark model list (updated 2026-10-25)
sources.evidence: Current recommended Pro revision 260915 has 1024k context; older 260628 has 256k. Both are listed for text generation, visual understanding, deep thinking and function calling. Pro does not appear in the audio-understanding table. These are documented capabilities, not an endpoint-operation test.

sources.title: Doubao Model Service Agreement
sources.evidence: Agreement effective 2026-09-23 covers the Doubao model service. Sections 5.1-5.2 retain ownership of model parameters, algorithms, code and structure and state these are not provided to users; supports proprietary, non-open-weight classification.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full text of the 87-page official June Seed2.0 card freshly retrieved October 27. Its comparison tables contain prices and capability results; no Seed2.1 Pro count or count-bearing base relationship is supplied. Parameter mentions concern worked software and scientific tasks.

sources.title: Periodic Weak Spots: Phase Sensitivity from Chunked KV-Cache Compression
sources.evidence: Later first-party mechanistic research examines DeepSeek-V4 and Qwen3-derived experimental transformers. Its searchable full text has no Seed2.1 occurrence, so it does not establish this model's architecture.

sources.title: ByteDance Seed Research
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. The current first-party research index includes October 25 Recycler and September 28 Periodic Weak Spots. Followed the new Recycler PDF and inspected its experimental comparisons; they identify research models, not Seed2.1 Pro or either dated Pro revision.

sources.title: Models.dev undated Seed 2.1 Pro base record
sources.evidence: Baseline provenance only: undated canonical name and ID, with 256000 context from August source notes; this is not primary technical verification.

sources.title: Models.dev Volcengine 260628 provider mapping
sources.evidence: The dated 260628 provider endpoint maps to the undated Seed 2.1 Pro base_model. This explains the old context value but does not uniquely freeze the canonical model to that revision.

sources.title: Seed2.1 current model overview and comparison tables
sources.evidence: Reopened and directly fetched October 27. The overview calls Pro and Turbo different model sizes without numeric sizes. Exact-Pro comparison columns report benchmark scores, not total or activated parameters. No publicly sized base is identified.

sources.title: Volcano Ark model list - official Markdown
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved with curl October 27 after web-reader failure. The complete 43,819-character Markdown separately lists Pro 260628, Pro 260915 and Seed Evolving, with capability, context/output and rate-limit columns. It supplies no model parameter counts or sized-base relationship. These revision and service comparisons do not justify transferring a generic Seed count.

sources.title: Recycler: Cost-Free Latent Reasoning via Hidden State Recycling
sources.evidence: Opened the October 25 original 18-page paper from the Seed research index on October 27. Inspected the method and experimental comparison sections and searched for Seed2.1. Counts describe a tiny 1B/151M experimental model and research models alpha/beta, with relative scaling comparisons; no exact-Pro occurrence, activated-count table or named production lineage is established.

sources.title: Doubao-Pro generic model listing - numeric lead resolution
sources.evidence: Opened and directly fetched October 27 to resolve a fresh Chinese numeric search lead. The generic Doubao-Pro listing labels size undisclosed while suggesting approximately 230B, and mixes 20B-active claims with explicitly older 1.5-Pro specifications and later 2.1 performance. It provides no exact Seed2.1 Pro count-bearing developer source or base mapping; these numbers are not accepted as specifications.

name.note: Normalized spacing of the official Seed2.1 Pro name.

developer.note: Official publisher and model-card author is ByteDance Seed.

family.note: The announcement explicitly places Pro in the Seed2.1 / Seed model family.

release_date.note: Initial public release announcement; neither the 260628 nor 260915 version suffix is substituted for the launch date.

open_weights.note: Hosted Doubao/Ark model; service terms do not provide parameters or source code, and no exact-model weight release was located.

license.note: Descriptive service-license classification supported by retained model ownership and restricted access; not an SPDX open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 English/Chinese nominal-size and named-base searches plus original, current and later first-party review found no developer-published Pro total or publicly sized base relationship. Both dated Pro revisions remain distinct in current documentation. The generic 230B lead mixes earlier Doubao generations; Recycler research does not identify this production model. Null reflects absent supported nominal evidence, not a tensor-census requirement.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked independently October 27 through active/activated searches and original/current/later comparison tables. No Pro activated count or counting convention was found. Tables report benchmark scores and service limits; earlier-generation 20B claims and experimental 151M counts do not apply. No total-to-active equality or sibling count is inferred.

architecture.note: The exact model's production architecture is not specified in checked cards. Later mechanistic research concerns other models; neither dense, MoE nor Transformer is inferred for Pro.

context_window.note: Current undated Pro uses documented 260915 context of 1024K; 1024000 is a nominal decimal normalization, not an exact token integer. The older 260628 revision is 256K. A dated provider mapping does not pin this undated canonical record.

modalities.note: Pro-specific visual/video evaluations and the current revision's visual-understanding listing support these inputs; text generation is explicit. No Pro audio support is established.

reasoning.note: Pro reasoning is documented; current API row explicitly supports deep thinking.

tool_call.note: The function-calling table explicitly marks both Pro revisions supported.

description.value: ByteDance Seed 2.1 model for multimodal reasoning, coding, and tool-assisted tasks.
description.note: Plain summary of documented Pro capabilities.

patch.notes: Context is nominal 1024K for current Pro revision doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260915; the earlier 260628 revision is 256K. The canonical record is undated. June 23 is the initial model launch, not either revision date. Nominal total and active counts remain undisclosed; no publicly sized base relationship is documented. Production architecture remains undisclosed; audio input is not established for Pro.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null total and active counts after fresh launch/current specifications, independent full-card searches, later first-party research and English/Chinese numeric/lineage checks. Generic 230B/20B claims mix generations; the new Recycler paper does not identify Pro. No supported nominal count or sized-base mapping was found.
